ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَا أَبَتِ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ لِي سَاجِدِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: When Yusuf said to his father, 'O my father, indeed I have seen eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَىٰ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْإِنسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.'

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ
ayahs.translation_en: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete His favor upon you.'

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالُوا لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ
ayahs.translation_en: When they said, 'Yusuf and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan.'

ayahs.arabic: اقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ أَوِ اطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ
ayahs.translation_en: 'Kill Yusuf or cast him out to another land; the countenance of your father will be only for you.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ
ayahs.translation_en: A speaker among them said, 'Do not kill Yusuf; but cast him into the bottom of the well.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا بِهِ وَأَجْمَعُوا أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِي غَيَابَتِ الْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: And when they went away with him and agreed to put him in the bottom of the well, We revealed to him, 'You will surely inform them of this affair of theirs while they do not perceive.'

ayahs.arabic: وَجَاءُوا عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ
ayahs.translation_en: And they brought upon his shirt false blood. He said, 'Rather, your souls have enticed you.'

ayahs.arabic: وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ فَأَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُ ۖ قَالَ يَا بُشْرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَامٌ
ayahs.translation_en: And there came a company of travelers; they sent their water-drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, 'Good news! This is a boy.'

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشْتَرَاهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِامْرَأَتِهِ أَكْرِمِي مَثْوَاهُ
ayahs.translation_en: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, 'Make his residence comfortable.'

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ آتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا
ayahs.translation_en: And when he reached maturity, We gave him judgment and knowledge.

ayahs.arabic: وَرَاوَدَتْهُ الَّتِي هُوَ فِي بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِ وَغَلَّقَتِ الْأَبْوَابَ
ayahs.translation_en: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. And she closed the doors.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِ ۖ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَا أَن رَّأَىٰ بُرْهَانَ رَبِّهِ
ayahs.translation_en: And she certainly determined him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof of his Lord.

ayahs.arabic: وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُ مِن دُبُرٍ
ayahs.translation_en: And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me.'

ayahs.arabic: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ ۖ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا إِنِّي أَرَانِي أَعْصِرُ خَمْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: And there entered with him two young men in the prison. One of them said, 'Indeed, I have seen myself pressing wine.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'There will not come to you any food that you are provided but that I will inform you of its interpretation.'

ayahs.arabic: يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ أَمَّا أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِي رَبَّهُ خَمْرًا
ayahs.translation_en: 'O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine.'

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ
ayahs.translation_en: And the king said, 'Indeed, I have seen seven fat cows being eaten by seven lean ones.'

ayahs.arabic: يُوسُفُ أَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيقُ أَفْتِنَا فِي سَبْعِ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ
ayahs.translation_en: 'Yusuf, O man of truth, advise us about seven fat cows.'

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: 'Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press.'

ayahs.arabic: وَجَاءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
ayahs.translation_en: And the brothers of Yusuf came and entered upon him, and he recognized them, but they did not recognize him.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْيَوْمَ ۖ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ آوَىٰ إِلَيْهِ أَبَوَيْهِ وَقَالَ ادْخُلُوا مِصْرَ إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ آمِنِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: And when they entered upon Yusuf, he took his parents to himself and said, 'Enter Egypt, if Allah wills, in security.'

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا لَهُ سُجَّدًا
ayahs.translation_en: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration.

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ ۖ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
ayahs.translation_en: My Lord, You have given me of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my Protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.'
